en.name: Stack CRM
en.lead: Pipeline, accounts, contacts, and forecasting on Postgres — with SSO against your IdP and webhooks for every state change. Built for teams that cannot put pipeline data in a US SaaS tenancy.
en.overview: Stack CRM is the customer system of record for sovereign installs. It runs on your Postgres (or ours on your metal), speaks REST and GraphQL, and fits the same identity and observability plane as Chat and Meet — so adding modules later is wiring, not a re-platform.
features: Self-hosted Postgres or your existing database
Custom fields, stages, and roles without vendor lock-in
Public REST + GraphQL APIs out of the box
SSO / IdP integration for staff access
Webhooks on deal and contact state changes
Air-gap capable — no mandatory cloud phone-home
useCases: Healthcare and advisory firms that need CRM inside their compliance boundary
Field sales teams that sync from on-site networks with intermittent WAN
Operators replacing HubSpot/Salesforce while keeping historical deals
deploy: Install beside Stack Chat / Meet on bare metal, VM, or your cloud tenancy
Connect IdP and map roles before cutover
Migrate accounts and opportunities via connectors; dry-run then zero-downtime switch
Operate with quarterly upgrades and on-call under the same support contract

en.name: Stack Chat
en.lead: Channels, threads, DMs, voice notes, and file sharing — end-to-end encrypted with keys you hold. Native agent bots with long-term memory, STT/TTS, and optional call join — still on your homeserver.
en.overview: Stack Chat is the collaboration spine of the suite. Search, files, and presence stay on infrastructure you control. Beyond human rooms, the same Matrix plane hosts knowledge bots that act as agents: they hear text or voice, retrieve durable context via GraphRAG (Neo4j associations + Qdrant vectors), answer with a local LLM, and can reply as text or TTS — with the room timeline as the audit trail. Positive feedback can be written back into long-term memory. Native clients cover desk and mobile so field and office share one secure plane.
features: E2E encryption with on-prem key custody
Full search index with no SaaS backhaul
Native iOS / Android / desktop clients
Channels, threads, DMs, voice notes, file sharing
Agent bots in rooms — tools, history, and durable GraphRAG memory (Neo4j + Qdrant)
Voice turns: STT (Faster-Whisper / Vosk) → RAG → local LLM → optional TTS (Piper / Coqui)
Optional Element Call / LiveKit join for voice agents; feedback loop refines the knowledge store
Air-gap deployment path for closed networks
Same identity model as CRM and Meet
useCases: Regulated orgs that forbid Slack/Teams cloud tenancies
Ops bridges between ward, clinic, and back-office without public chat SaaS
On-prem knowledge assistants in Element — text, voice message, or call — grounded in your Markdown KB
Incident rooms that must stay on LAN during WAN outages
deploy: Stand up with the shared control plane and IdP
Import channel history where connectors exist; otherwise phased cutover
Roll out desktop and mobile clients with MDM if required
Optional: attach go-second-brain / GraphRAG bot + STT/TTS workers on the same LAN
Patch and upgrade on the suite cadence

All-hands and training webinars inside the corporate network
Hybrid sites that prefer LAN media with optional WAN bridges
deploy: Size SFU nodes for concurrent rooms and peak participants
Point recordings at S3-compatible storage you control
Join the suite SSO and calendar hooks as needed
Load-test before cutover; keep Zoom as fall-back only if policy allows
